_note: Rating rules for the Privileged Access Drift report. Cut-offs marked proposal were not stated in the original CISO Rpt 2 and are Fluency proposals.

high: any tier-0 application permission granted in the window
a role assigned outside PIM by a person, or by an application that does not reverse its grants (not time-boxed), or a PIM alert with no resolution
administrator single-factor sign-ins above 50% of successful administrator sign-ins
elevated: permanent role grants added in PIM or outside PIM (time-boxed automation counts)
enabled administrators with no registered MFA method (proposal)

_timeboxed_note: An application that removes at least this share of the roles it adds is treated as time-boxing them (privileged-access tooling); the finding stays but is not rated high (proposal).
